method: Built-in image generation; converted with scripts/portrait_to_ascii.py

scenes.brief: Scene: The creator goddess cups a small living world between her enormous hands. Her calm face and flowing pale hair occupy the upper left, her two hands cradle a little round landscape below center, containing one winding river, three tiny trees, and a cluster of roofs. The world's rim is a simple bright curve, not a detailed globe. A distant narrow dark silhouette of her jealous brother watches from the far right, separated by blackness. Loving creation and a hint of envy. Clear large shapes.
scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one wide 16:9 opening-cutscene plate for SOMNIA, an ASCII fantasy RPG. A stark old myth illustrated as tiny monochrome retro pixel art with a woodcut sensibility. Designed on a 192x108 pixel grid, enlarged cleanly. Pure black background, white and three gray values only. Bold angular pixel clusters, broad readable silhouettes, generous black negative space, very restrained fine detail. This will be converted to 112 columns by about 38 rows of ASCII, so the composition must read small. Do not draw ASCII characters yourself. No letters, captions, frames, UI, watermark, color, soft gradients, photographic realism, tiny fussy details. The creator goddess is a solemn adult woman with long flowing pale hair and a simple dark robe, no crown, no moon symbolism. Her jealous brother is a tall dark angular figure with a pale narrow featureless face, no horns or armor. All views are mythic and symbolic rather than literal space or modern astronomy.

Use case: illustration-story. Create a new replacement opening plate for SOMNIA, a black-background ASCII fantasy game. Wide 16:9. Extremely simple two-tone silhouette illustration, white shapes on pure black, designed to remain instantly recognizable at only 112 by 38 character cells. A fallen creator goddess lies horizontally across the left and lower middle, clear profile with nose and closed eye cutout, flowing long white hair, one arm outstretched. Her jealous brother stands upright on the right, a tall angular hoodless robed figure with one raised arm. Between them above the fallen goddess is one large broken circular world split into THREE big separate white chunks with generous black cracks. Composition reads fallen woman, standing attacker, broken world. Huge bold untextured shapes, flat white with black cutouts, no midgray, no shading, no hatching, no stippling, no debris, no stars, no background landscape, no tiny details, no text or frames. All three subjects separated by black negative space. Folk fable woodcut silhouette mood. Not ASCII characters yet; image will be converted afterwards.

scenes.brief: Scene: Close profile of the creator goddess lying asleep, eyes gently closed, her pale hair flowing into the contours of a restored countryside. Within the sweep of her hair are a winding river, a little medieval village, and distant hills, as though her dreaming mind contains the entire living world. Her face on the left and the small world on the right are equally legible. The outer background is pure black. Gentle light, fragile peace. No celestial moon, no modern globe, no floating text. Use large simple white and grey masses with crisp black cutouts.
